headlines.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 24 points and 18 rebounds in his first victory with the Heat, leading Miami over the Atlanta Hawks 129-117 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giannis Antetokounmpo has 24 points, 18 rebounds as the Heat beat the Hawks 129-117 for first win

headlines.description: — Evan Mobley had 24 points, Peyton Watson added 22 and the Cleveland Cavaliers rallied in the second half for a 121-111 victory over the Washington Wizards on Wednesday night, spoiling AJ Dybantsa's NBA debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mobley and the Cavaliers storm back to beat the Wizards 121-111 in Dybantsa's debut

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham scored 30 points to help the Detroit Pistons hold off the Charlotte Hornets 97-89 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cade Cunningham scores 30 points to help the Pistons hold off the Hornets, 97-89

headlines.description: — Tyrese Maxey scored 27 points, including two 3-pointers in the final 1 1/2 minutes, to lift the Philadelphia 76ers to a 114-109 victory over the Indiana Pacers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maxey scores 27 points and leads the 76ers to a 114-109 victory over the Pacers

headlines.description: — Scottie Barnes scored 28 points, RJ Barrett had 25 and the Toronto Raptors routed Orlando Magic 129-99 on Wednesday night to open a two-game set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barrett, Barnes lead the Raptors in a 129-99 romp over the Magic

events.name: New York Knicks at Chicago Bulls

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson had 38 points and seven assists, and the New York Knicks beat the Chicago Bulls 133-127 on Wednesday night for their second straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Brunson scores 38 points as the Knicks beat the Bulls 133-127

headlines.description: — Fred VanVleet scored 24 points and Amen Thompson added 23 as the Houston Rockets remained undefeated with a 132-100 rout of the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fred VanVleet and Amen Thompson lift undefeated Rockets past Bucks, 132-100

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Stephen Curry scored a season-high 44 points, rookie Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 and Golden State Warriors held on Wednesday night for a 119-114 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves, who were without injured guard Anthony Edwards.
headlines.shortLinkText: Curry scores 44 points as the Warriors hold on to beat the Timberwolves 119-114

events.name: Denver Nuggets at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists for his 200th career triple-double in the regular season, and the Denver Nuggets never trailed in a 104-91 victory over the winless New Orleans Pelicans on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikola Jokic notches 200th career triple-double as the Nuggets down the Pelicans, 104-91

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Utah Jazz

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama had 36 points and 14 rebounds, and the San Antonia Spurs beat the short-handed Utah Jazz 117-111 in overtime on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama scores 36 points and the Spurs clamp down in overtime to beat the Jazz 117-111

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Dallas Mavericks

headlines.description: — Cooper Flagg had 26 points and eight assists and P.J. Washington scored 18 points as the Dallas Mavericks beat the injury-depleted Oklahoma City Thunder 120-96 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper Flagg has 26 points, 8 assists as Mavericks beat depleted Thunder 120-96

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at LA Clippers

headlines.description: — Quentin Grimes scored 23 points, Collin Sexton added a season-high 21 points off the bench, and the Los Angeles Lakers — without Luka Doncic — beat the Los Angeles Clippers 103-87 on Wednesday night for the second time in a week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lakers rout Clippers 103-87 without Luka Doncic
